name: GameDeck | Xbox - Library and Playtime Sync

nodes.name: Every 6h Trigger
nodes.notes: Live since 2026-08-13. Also runs inside the Refresh Trigger chain after PSN.

nodes.name: Refresh Access Token
nodes.notes: Public client. client_id only, no client_secret. MSA reads the form body only on this endpoint.

nodes.name: Store Rotated Token
nodes.notes: Must stay ahead of every data fetch. A failure after refreshing but before storing burns the rotation chain and the sync dies silently weeks later.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { RelyingParty: 'http://auth.xboxlive.com', TokenType: 'JWT', Properties: { AuthMethod: 'RPS', SiteName: 'user.auth.xboxlive.com', RpsTicket: 'd=' + $('Refresh Access Token').first().json.access_token } } }}

nodes.name: Get Existing Xbox Rows
nodes.notes: This select and the field list in Resolve and Merge are coupled. A field that Xbox may skip MUST be selected here, or the carry-forward silently writes null. This is the OWNED_BY_ENV trap from the Exophase workflow.

nodes.name: Fetch MinutesPlayed
nodes.notes: Body key is titleid, all lowercase. The upstream models serialise through a LowerCaseModel; titleId with a capital I returns nothing and looks like zero coverage.

nodes.name: Upsert Games
nodes.notes: Disabled until the dry run is reviewed. Enable only after checking regressions, superseded and fields_left_alone.

nodes.name: Insert Play Events
nodes.notes: Must run in the same execution as Upsert Games. Splitting them is what cost four days of Steam sessions.

nodes.name: Date Play Events
nodes.notes: Which calendar day a session belongs to is a product decision (the reader's day), not an infrastructure setting. Pinned here so it cannot drift with the instance timezone.

nodes.name: Build Unmatched Discovery Queries
nodes.notes: Only recent unmatched titles with positive Xbox playtime enter discovery. Apps, demos, betas and test branches are never auto-created; old unmatched titles remain reported but are not backfilled into fake activity.

nodes.name: Match Unmatched to IGDB
nodes.notes: Reuses the same private GameDeck /api/discover service credential as the live Game Pass matcher. No new secret or credential is introduced.

nodes.name: Resolve Unmatched Discovery
nodes.notes: Requires a high-confidence title match on an Xbox-platform IGDB result, rejects add-ons and ambiguity, reuses existing Xbox rows by IGDB identity when unique, otherwise mints 3e12 + Xbox title id. First recent play uses the lifetime total as the session baseline, exactly like Steam/PSN/Exophase.

nodes.name: Upsert Resolved Xbox Games
nodes.notes: Separate from the established Xbox bulk upsert so existing uniform-payload behavior is untouched. This branch adds igdb_id only for newly resolved titles or carries the existing id.

nodes.name: Insert Resolved Xbox Play Events
nodes.notes: Uses the existing (master_id,event_date) conflict key and database same-day merge trigger. Events are already dated in America/New_York by last_played.

meta.credentialNote: Credential bindings are intentionally omitted from source control. Rebind the existing n8n credentials after import.
